items.title: How does big-bang cutover's expected value change as the outage probability shifts?
items.description: Big-bang cutover's outcomes are fixed at $2,000 if it goes fine and $60,000 if it doesn't -- only the estimated 20% outage probability is uncertain, and it's an estimate, not a measurement. Drag the slider to see how far a probability error would have to be off before big-bang cutover's expected value crosses staged rollout's fixed $17,300 -- the point where EV alone would stop favoring it.

params.name: outageProbability
params.label: Estimated probability of a multi-hour outage

items.compute: const p = params.outageProbability / 100; const ev = (1 - p) * 2000 + p * 60000; return { ev };
